insights_guidelines: detected_patterns: observations confirmed in 3+ days of the week.
pending: items the agent should keep in mind (NEVER framework bugs).
automation_suggestions: actionable proposals to be reviewed.
Limit: 30 patterns, 20 pending, 10 suggestions. Old items (30+ days without mention) auto-archived.
soul_guidelines: name, mission, tone, values are stable — edit manually only.
behavior_rules: max 15 rules. Weekly compilation adds/removes 1 per week.
Rules describe HOW the agent acts, not WHO the residents are (that's in users.json).
users_guidelines: One key per resident. Use short, descriptive keys (alice, bob).
role: living situation (primary resident, partner, child, guest).
response_style: how to address this person.
restrictions: things this user does NOT want to be alerted about.
observed_patterns: behavior patterns learned from interactions (NOT preferences).
agent_automations_guidelines: Validated against HA entity registry before being created.
User can disable/enable without removing via Telegram buttons.
monitoring_guidelines: monitored_entities.json synced daily from HA entity registry.
Only entities exposed to voice assistants are monitored by default.
events: optional list of state changes to log to daily file.
After editing events, run generate_buffer_events.py and reload automations.
